item.description:

item.title: Wall Street just lost $285B because of 13 Markdown files
item.description:
📝 This incident really leans into a deeper issue though that I've been thinking about. Instead of SaaS being replaced by "agentically-built" SaaS, what if people just don't need (as much) SaaS. This gets even more powerful with the agent having access to source material.
🔗 Read more: https://martinalderson.com/posts/wall-street-lost-285-billion-because-of-13-markdown-files/

item.title: Show HN: Smooth CLI – Token-efficient browser for AI agents
item.description:
